verdict.rationale: Typesense explicitly documents hybrid search combining vector similarity and keyword matching ('Typesense combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector search, hybrid search, semantic search, and geo search'), with a dedicated 'Semantic Search' guide section and a public demo app explicitly labeled 'Semantic / Hybrid search on 300K HN comments'. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of hybrid fusion quality/relevance beyond vendor docs and demo links.
